name: spt-migration-test
title: SPT Migration Test
author: versuffer
description: Headless migration test driver for the space-power-transmitter: builds a link on a map hosted with the 1.x mod (an export accumulator port), then re-hosts the same save with the current mod and asserts the on_configuration_changed migration carried the record, the fresh dynamic-priority export port and the link over. Enabled only by tests/run.sh in a temporary mod directory; never ship or enable it in a real game.
